description: The 'dss_apps_cached' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of applications, capturing essential metadata and visibility details. It is particularly useful for managing and analyzing applications within a platform, such as Dataiku, by offering insights into each application's unique identifier, version, and descriptive labels. The dataset includes information on whether an application has limited visibility or an associated image, which can be crucial for user interface considerations. Additionally, it tracks the origin of the application, whether from a project or plugin, and the number of instances, which helps in understanding application usage and deployment. The dataset also includes tags in JSON array format, providing a flexible way to categorize and search applications. URLs for accessing each application are provided, facilitating direct navigation. This dataset is valuable for developers, project managers, and data scientists who need to manage application lifecycles, optimize resource allocation, and ensure efficient application deployment and usage.
shortDesc: Dataset of cached applications with metadata and visibility details.

columns.name: onlyLimitedVisibility
columns.comment: Indicates if app has limited visibility, boolean value.

columns.name: appId
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each application, text format.

columns.name: appVersion
columns.comment: Version information of the application, text format.

columns.name: label
columns.comment: Descriptive label for the application, free text.

columns.name: shortDesc
columns.comment: Short description of the application, free text.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the application, JSON array format.

columns.name: isAppImg
columns.comment: Indicates if app has an image, boolean value.

columns.name: origin
columns.comment: Source of the application, either project or plugin.

columns.name: originProjectKey
columns.comment: Key of the originating project, text format.

columns.name: instanceCount
columns.comment: Number of instances of the application, integer value.

columns.name: useAsRecipe
columns.comment: Indicates if app is used as a recipe, boolean value.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL for accessing the application, string format.
